crossRefs.note: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the meat at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and there eat it and the bread…
Yes, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man who sacrificed, “Give meat to roast for…
and one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before…
With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that…
He put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

translations.web: The priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them on the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved the head of his separation;
translations.bsb: And the priest is to take the boiled shoulder from the ram, one unleavened cake from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and put them into the hands of the Nazirite who has just shaved the hair of his consecration.
translations.kjv: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:
translations.asv: And the priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazirite, after he hath shaven the head of his separation;
